thread:
maria: Heads-up — I'm starting a short proposal thread on how we standardize adapter behavior at the gateway for degraded model variants. TL;DR: prefer explicit routing headers + a small fallback protocol.
jon: curious — is this primarily about cost-tier fallbacks or compatibility when a model is missing?
maria: both. example: if regional pool can't serve fp16 model, we downgrade to a smaller quantized variant. Need consistent signals so clients can opt-in/out.
lee: 👍 can you sketch the headers we'd use? we shouldn't invent too many new ones.
maria: proposal:
```
X-RW-Model-Variant: v1-8bit-q
X-RW-Fallback-Allowed: true|false
X-RW-Route-Preference: latency|cost|quality
```
sasha: +1 to explicit. also we need telemetry hooks to tie rollout UX to quality regressions. Suggest emitting `rw.routing.decision` events with reason tags.
jon: what about REST↔gRPC parity? If edge translates, we need consistent behavior regardless of protocol.
maria: yeah, two options:
  1) Gateway enforces headers and semantics (single-source-of-truth). Edge does translation.
  2) Clients talk to adapter directly (typed gRPC) and we only translate for legacy REST.
lee: Option 1 centralizes control (good for rollout), Option 2 is simpler for typed teams. We should evaluate cost of translation latency.
infra-bot: deploy scheduled: gateway-adapter-v2 will ship canary tomorrow @ 03:00 UTC — watch `gateway.routing.*` metrics.
sasha: For quotas: if we automatically downgrade variant, token accounting changes. We need metric tags: `model.variant` and `billing.variant` so cost math remains auditable.
maria: Agree. Also UX: console should show per-route fallback rate + impact on SLA. Can we reuse existing per-route dashboard tile?
jon: we can add a small panel: fallback rate, avg latency delta, estimated cost delta. That should be low-risk.
lee: one last thing — error semantics. If fallback fails, do we return 503 or the higher-latency option? I vote higher-latency (graceful degradation) unless route opted out.
sasha: make `X-RW-Fallback-Allowed` default to true, but expose policy per key/route in console.
maria: ok I'll draft a short RFC with examples and a tiny adapter shim that maps headers <-> proto fields. will post link shortly. thanks everyone :rocket:
